body: Release log = LogPlugin::fmt_layer tee (stderr + gta_like.log next to exe, no ANSI), not file-only: QA brp.py release runs and Linux terminal users keep stderr. Console hidden gated statically by a PE Subsystem==2 check in package/verify instead of only the runtime boot.

Fatal-error dialog: recommend windows-sys =0.52.0 (already in Cargo.lock via winit with Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging) over a hand-written user32 extern block or a dialog crate; one static LOG_FILE opened at the top of main instead of inside log_layer.
